nodes.label: iptables comment marker (iclaude-pii-dnat:<tap>)
nodes.rationale: Stable identifier requiring no external state file (no PID, no port). The iptables comment module is part of universal Linux kernel iptables build.

nodes.label: P1: Silent failure when passwordless sudo unavailable
nodes.rationale: Current code gates DNAT block via sudo -n true; if unavailable, block is skipped silently. Guest cannot reach proxy and failure surfaces as opaque network error inside Claude Code.
nodes.norm_label: p1: silent failure when passwordless sudo unavailable

nodes.label: P2: Stale iptables rules after crash
nodes.rationale: If stop_microvm() does not run (SIGKILL, OOM, host panic), DNAT/INPUT rules persist and accumulate across sessions, unidentifiable without external state.
nodes.norm_label: p2: stale iptables rules after crash

nodes.label: P5: route_localnet=1 not reset
nodes.rationale: Sysctl persists on the TAP iface; if statically provisioned, the setting leaks. Low risk, cheap to fix.

nodes.label: E2E debug flags (--e2e-exit-after-boot, --e2e-kill-after-boot)
nodes.rationale: Gated by ICLAUDE_E2E_HEADLESS=1 so they cannot be invoked accidentally; required to simulate clean exit and crash for L3 tests.

nodes.label: Caveman
nodes.rationale: Compresses output tokens by ~65-75% via terse model response style; does not affect code, commits, security warnings, or error quotes.

nodes.label: Caveman isolated installer (lib/caveman/install.sh)
nodes.rationale: Standard caveman installer patches ~/.claude/settings.json which is incompatible with iclaude isolated env (CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR). Wrapper redirects all writes to .nvm-isolated/.claude-isolated/.

nodes.label: Caveman Auto-Clarity
nodes.rationale: Reverts to normal style for security warnings, irreversible action confirmations, multi-step sequences where fragment order increases misread risk, and clarification requests.

nodes.label: normalize-paths.py hook
nodes.rationale: Two-way PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook flips manifest, root, and cache/ast paths abs<->rel around every graphify invocation. Brittle workaround until upstream lands.

nodes.label: _patch_graphify_watch shim
nodes.rationale: Runtime shim that patches watch.py to pass manifest_path explicitly so manifest lands inside GRAPHIFY_OUT/.

nodes.label: Graphify portability patches (4 patches)
nodes.rationale: Upstream graphifyy writes absolute paths in manifest, .graphify_root, and cache; breaks the graph when the repo moves between machines. Four idempotent patches relativize paths so the graph is portable via git.

nodes.label: SSH ControlMaster + rsync sync
nodes.rationale: One persistent TCP connection for all sync ops reduces overhead from 150-320ms handshake to ~5ms; rsync delta-sync cuts transfer 90%+ on small changes.

nodes.label: Named microVM snapshots
nodes.rationale: Save full VM state (memory, disks, network) to skip cold kernel boot on resume; tied to specific Firecracker version (incompatible across upgrades, fallback to cold boot).

nodes.label: KVM hypervisor as security boundary
nodes.rationale: Capabilities inside the guest do not extend beyond the VM; any exploit remains isolated within guest kernel. Privilege escalation inside VM via SUID is acceptable since it does not breach KVM isolation.

nodes.label: Workspace sync modes (full/isolated)
nodes.rationale: full = bidirectional sync host<->guest; isolated = host->guest only, used to give claude read access while preventing modification of originals.

nodes.label: copy reasoning to content (not move)
nodes.rationale: Preserves thinking blocks in extended output; only the reasoning content is copied to delta.content for Claude Code visibility

nodes.label: universal support for all Ollama models
nodes.rationale: Plugin uses conditional checks (delta.reasoning non-empty AND delta.content empty) to passthrough unchanged for non-reasoning models
nodes.norm_label: universal support for all ollama models

nodes.label: CCR transformer.use reverse order execution
nodes.rationale: Array transformers applied in reverse order; placing ollama-reasoning last in use array runs it first on raw Ollama SSE before built-in reasoning transformer

nodes.label: avoid double-run of transformer
nodes.rationale: CCR applies provider-level and per-model use chains independently; adding ollama-reasoning to provider-level only prevents wasteful duplicate execution

hyperedges.description: Ollama reasoning transformer is part of the CCR transformer.use chain, executed after sampling and before reasoning in reverse order
Delta.reasoning copied to delta.content in Format A, then reasoning transformer converts to Anthropic thinking blocks in Format B, preserving both paths
Three core design decisions: copy reasoning instead of moving, support all Ollama models via passthrough, and rely on reverse execution order for correct pipeline position
